lines.en: label beachmas15:
Somewhere on the other side of town...
lines.zh: 在小镇的另一头……

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas1
: WHO DESIGNED THIS FUCKING COSTUME?! DO THEY SERIOUSLY EXPECT ME TO BE ABLE TO GET THIS FUCKING STUPID ASS RIBBON OFF BY MYSELF?! FUCK!
lines.zh: : 这套操蛋的戏服到底是谁设计的？！他们还真指望我自己把这根蠢得要死的缎带解下来吗？！操！

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas2
: Hey. The cafe was out of like, every single herbal tea...so I hope you’re cool with sencha.
lines.zh: : 嘿。咖啡厅里的花草茶差不多全卖光了……所以希望你不介意喝煎茶。

lines.en: : I’M NOT!
lines.zh: : 我介意！

lines.en: : Okay. Guess I’ll just go fuck myself then.
lines.zh: : 好啊。那我还是去死好了。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas3
: Great idea! And if you see my costume designer while you’re out there, tell her she should go to Hell for creating the world’s most complicated ribbon!
lines.zh: : 好主意！还有，你要是在外面碰见我的服装设计师，替我告诉她，她做出了全世界最复杂的缎带，应该下地狱！

lines.en: : I’ve only got twenty minutes to get out of this fucking thing and into my second outfit and I can’t do that if it’s going to be a whole ass puzzle, Otoha!
lines.zh: : 我只有二十分钟，要从这鬼东西里钻出来再换上第二套衣服，可它要是跟个该死的谜题似的，我根本来不及啊，Otoha！

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Why are you still holding my tea?! Put it down! I’m thirsty!
lines.zh: : 你还端着我的茶干嘛？！放下！我渴死了！

lines.en: : But you said-
lines.zh: : 可你刚说——

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter what I said! Just put it down!
lines.zh: : 我说什么都不重要！放下就是了！

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas4
: Jeez, Niki. You’re a real backstage-diva aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 天哪，Niki。你可真是个十足的后台女王啊。

lines.en: : I wasn’t even supposed to be playing this fucking show! Can’t I have one Christmas off?!
lines.zh: : 这场破演出我本来根本就不用上的！就不能让我过一个安生圣诞节吗？！

lines.en: : The only reason I’m even here is because your asshole teacher never responded to my date request! And God forbid I find anything else worth spending my time on!
lines.zh: : 我会在这儿，全都是因为你那个混蛋老师一直没回我的约会邀请！而且老天在上，我居然找不到别的值得花时间的事！

lines.en: : But hey! That’s great because it gives me all the time in the fucking world to remove this FUCKING RIBBON!
lines.zh: : 不过嘿！也挺好，这样我就有他妈大把大把的时间来拆这根操蛋的缎带了！

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas5
: Would you like some help, princess?
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙吗，公主大人？

lines.en: : Obviously! What the fuck is taking you so long?!
lines.zh: : 那还用说！你他妈磨蹭什么呢？！

lines.en: scene black
scene nikiotohaxmas6
: I’m sorry for yelling at you. Noriko normally helps me with this sort of thing, but of course she gets to bail and spend Christmas with my ex-boyfriend while I do this.
lines.zh: : 抱歉刚才冲你吼。平时这种事都是 Noriko 帮我弄的，可她当然可以拍拍屁股走人，去和我前男友过圣诞，留我一个人在这儿折腾。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sorry for not being Noriko.
lines.zh: : 那好吧，抱歉我不是 Noriko。

lines.en: : Don’t be. That outfit looks better on you than it would her anyway.
lines.zh: : 别这么说。反正那套衣服穿在你身上，比穿在她身上好看。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas7
: Thanks. Though, I’m still not really sure why there is a dress code involved for just being your assistant.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。不过我还是不太明白，光是当你的助理而已，为什么还要有着装要求。

lines.en: : Shut up. There’s obviously no dress code for being my assistant. But there is a dress code for going up on stage, which Noriko was going to do for Tokimeki Labyrinth this year, BUT NOPE!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。当我的助理当然没有着装要求。可上台有啊，本来今年 Tokimeki Labyrinth 那段是 Noriko 上的，结果呢，没戏！

lines.en: : Do you know the words? Can you go up there instead?
lines.zh: : 你会歌词吗？能替她上台吗？

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas8
: Up...on stage?! With you?! In front of all of those people?!
lines.zh: : 上……上台？！还跟你一起？！当着那么多人的面？！

lines.en: : What’s the matter? You’ll be playing for just as many people as I am one day, won’t you? And you’re a better singer than Noriko. So, will you do it or not?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？总有一天你也要在同样多的人面前演出的，不是吗？而且你唱得比 Noriko 好。所以，你到底上不上？

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas9
: Uhh...it’s kind of...really short notice. And I know the words to the chorus but I’m not sure if I know them well enough to-
lines.zh: : 呃……这有点……太临时了吧。副歌的歌词我倒是记得，但我不确定熟到能——

lines.en: : Fuck it. I’ll just do it alone again. But if you’re going to keep studying under me, you’re going to have to accept that you’re going to be thrown into the fire from time to time.
lines.zh: : 算了。我还是自己上吧。不过你要是还想继续跟着我学，就得接受自己时不时被推进火坑里这件事。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas10
: Oh, thank God. I was like five seconds away from having a full blown panic attack.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。我差五秒钟就要彻底惊恐发作了。

lines.en: : Get over it. At least you get to hang out here in the nice, cool dressing room while I’m out there sweating my ass off, wondering why they had to choose the heaviest fabric in the world for a summer concert.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。起码你还能待在这间又舒服又凉快的化妆室里，而我呢，得在外面热得汗流浃背，还得琢磨他们干嘛非要在夏日演唱会上挑全世界最厚的布料。

lines.en: : You can cool off in a second. I just have to figure out the ribbon.
lines.zh: : 你马上就能凉快了。我只要搞定这根缎带就行。

lines.en: : It’s fucking ridiculous, isn’t it? I’m an idol, not Harry fucking Houdini.
lines.zh: : 简直荒唐到极点，对吧？我是偶像，又不是哈里·该死的·胡迪尼。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas11
: You know, you’re really lucky I skipped out on the beach trip this year.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我今年没去海边旅行，你能碰上我可真是走运。

lines.en: : Otherwise, you’d still be screaming and breaking things and your fans would only have one gorgeous dress they’d get to admire this year.
lines.zh: : 不然你现在还在那儿又吼又砸东西，而你的粉丝今年也就只有一条漂亮裙子可以欣赏了。

lines.en: : Yeah. Thanks for coming on such short notice. And for skipping out on your Christmas date this year just to help me.
lines.zh: : 嗯。谢谢你这么临时还赶过来。也谢谢你为了帮我，把今年的圣诞约会都推了。

lines.en: : Oh, we didn’t have anything like that planned. We’re in a...pretty rough spot right now, actually.
lines.zh: : 哦，我们本来也没那种安排。其实……我们现在的状态挺糟的。

lines.en: : Yeah, what else is fucking new?
lines.zh: : 是吗，还能有什么新鲜事呢。

lines.en: scene black
: There. Got it.
lines.zh: : 好了。解开了。

lines.en: : AAAAAHHHHH THANK FUCK! I can finally breathe!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊谢天谢地！我终于能喘气了！

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas12
: So, what are you two fighting about this time? What did you do now?
lines.zh: : 那么，这回你俩又吵什么？这次你又干了什么？

lines.en: : Me? What makes you think I’m the one who did something?
lines.zh: : 我？你凭什么觉得是我干了什么？

lines.en: : Because your last fight was all about you pretending your parents were homophobic so you wouldn’t have to explain to Rin that you were embarrassed to be dating a girl.
lines.zh: : 因为你们上次吵架，不就是你假装你父母恐同，好不用跟 Rin 解释，你其实是为跟一个女生交往而难为情吗。

lines.en: : It was...a little more complicated than that, Niki.
lines.zh: : 事情比那个……要复杂一点，Niki。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas13
: Of course it was. Everything always has to be complicated with you fucking lesbians. Do you know what I was doing when I was your age, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 当然复杂了。你们这群该死的女同性恋，什么事都得搞复杂。Otoha，你知道我在你这个年纪都在干什么吗？

lines.en: : You really don’t have to-
lines.zh: : 你真的不必——

lines.en: : I was jerking off and blowing the same guy nearly every single day for five years. And do you know how many times we fought?
lines.zh: : 我那五年里，几乎每天都要给同一个男人打飞机、口交。你知道我们吵过几次吗？

lines.en: : No, Niki...
lines.zh: : 不知道，Niki……

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas14

: Well, neither do I! But it seemed to be a lot less than you and Rin and at least one of those fights involved me also liking girls! What this means is that lesbians are cursed and nothing but trouble. The end.
lines.zh: : 哼，我也不知道！但感觉比你和 Rin 少太多了，而且我们那些架里至少有一回，还扯上了我也喜欢女生！这说明什么？说明女同性恋就是被诅咒的，全是麻烦。完毕。

lines.en: : You do realize I’m bi, right? I’m not a lesbian. Rin too.
lines.zh: : 你知道我是双性恋吧？我不是女同性恋。Rin 也不是。

lines.en: : Whoopdy-fucking-doo. Who isn’t bisexual today? Do you want a medal?
lines.zh: : 哦——真他妈了不起。这年头谁还不是个双性恋了？想要块奖牌吗？

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas15
: Don’t fucking ignore me!
lines.zh: : 别他妈装听不见！

lines.en: : I’m not! It’s just a complicated situation and I don’t really have any idea how to talk about it without both sounding controlling and making you mad.
lines.zh: : 我没有！只是情况太复杂了，我真不知道该怎么说，才能既不显得控制欲强，又不把你惹毛。

lines.en: : Me?! Mad?! Why would I ever get mad about anything?! I’m nice!
lines.zh: : 我？！生气？！我有什么好生气的？！我脾气好得很！

lines.en: : You...sure are, Niki.
lines.zh: : 你……确实是，Niki。

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...sit the fuck down, Otoha. It’s time we have a talk.
lines.zh: : 哈……给我坐下，Otoha。我们该好好谈谈了。

lines.en: : I already know how babies are made. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 孩子是怎么来的我早就知道了。谢了。

lines.en: : A talk about relationships, you little cunt. Your stupid attitude is getting me down and I still have half a show to do.
lines.zh: : 是谈感情，你这个小混蛋。你这副蠢样子搞得我心情都差了，我后面还有半场演出呢。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas16
: Rin is on that stupid beach trip too, isn’t she? Don’t tell me the only reason you skipped out on it is to avoid her.
lines.zh: : Rin 也在那个破海边旅行里吧？别告诉我你推掉它的唯一理由就是为了躲她。

lines.en: : Fine. I won’t tell you. So let's just talk about something else instead so you can give your throat a rest before-
lines.zh: : 好。我不说。那我们聊点别的吧，你也让嗓子歇歇，等——

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas17
: Were you not listening to me?! I blew the same guy every day for five years! I have the fucking Arnold Schwarzenegger of throats, Otoha!
lines.zh: : 你没在听我说话吗？！我连着五年天天给同一个男人口交！我的嗓子可是阿诺德·施瓦辛格级别的，Otoha！

lines.en: : That’s such a weird analogy! Be more normal!
lines.zh: : 这比喻也太怪了！你能不能正常点！

lines.en: : What right do you have to tell me to be more normal when you’re coping with your relationship issues by just ignoring them?!
lines.zh: : 你自己靠装看不见来应付感情问题，有什么资格让我正常点？！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea who you remind me of right now?!
lines.zh: : 你知道你现在让我想起谁吗？！

lines.en: : A...bitch?
lines.zh: : 一个……婊子？

lines.en: : My stupid ex-boyfriend! Because he always did the same exact shit and, let me tell you, it’s fucking annoying!
lines.zh: : 我那个蠢前男友！因为他以前干的就是一模一样的事，说真的，烦死人了！

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas18
: Well, that would certainly explain why Rin likes me.
lines.zh: : 哦，那倒确实能解释 Rin 为什么喜欢我了。

lines.en: : Bullshit. I’ve only met her once, but it was clear as day that that girl likes you because you’re talented and pretty. Which is, fundamentally, the same reason anyone likes anyone.
lines.zh: : 放屁。我只见过她一次，但明摆着，那丫头喜欢你是因为你有才华又漂亮。说到底，谁喜欢谁不都是因为这个。

lines.en: : And I say this as perhaps the most beloved figure in all of Kumon-mi for those exact characteristics.
lines.zh: : 而这话可是全 Kumon-mi 也许最受欢迎的人——凭的也正是这两点——说的。

lines.en: : If she liked you because you reminded her of someone else, why the fuck would she not just go be with that person instead? And why would she freak out and storm out the way she did at the restaurant?
lines.zh: : 如果她喜欢你是因为你让她想起别人，那她干嘛不直接去找那个人？还有，她在餐厅里为什么会崩溃到夺门而出？

lines.en: : You’re really not the person I want to have this conversation with, Niki.
lines.zh: : Niki，我真的不想跟你谈这个。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas19
: Why the fuck not?! I’m more than just a mentor to you, aren’t I?! Look at me as a...cool authority figure with more life experience and shit!
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？！对你来说，我不只是个导师吧？！把我当成……一个很酷、人生经验丰富的长辈之类的！

lines.en: : That’s part of the problem! You’re too old to-
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿！你太老了，老到——

lines.en: : Watch it.
lines.zh: : 你给我注意点。

lines.en: : You’re too...experienced to be getting yourself wrapped up in petty drama like what’s going on between two teenagers!
lines.zh: : 你太……阅历丰富了，不该掺和进两个小屁孩之间这种鸡毛蒜皮的破事里！

lines.en: : It’s my first relationship ever and, let’s be real, there’s no way it’s going to last forever. You’d have to be delusional to follow the same person for your entire-
lines.zh: : 这可是我头一次谈恋爱，说实话，它不可能持续一辈子的。要跟着同一个人走完你的整整一——那得是妄想。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas20
: Watch it.
lines.zh: : 你给我注意点。

lines.en: : What...What I’m saying is that this shouldn’t even be a blip on your radar. There’s no reason for you to even care about what’s going on with my love life.
lines.zh: : 我……我想说的是，这种事根本不该进入你的视线。你没理由在意我的感情生活出了什么问题。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas21
: Well, why the Hell not? I care about you and respect you enough to want any relationship you’re in to succeed. Not fail.
lines.zh: : 那凭什么？我在乎你、尊重你，所以我才希望你拥有的每一段感情都能成，而不是黄。

lines.en: : Please don’t try and give me some kind of speech that ends with a major realization and me taking the last bus across town to go tell Rin I love her.
lines.zh: : 求你别给我来那一套演讲——最后让我恍然大悟，然后搭末班车横穿全城去跟 Rin 说我爱她。

lines.en: : Do you love her?
lines.zh: : 你爱她吗？

lines.en: : What do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Does she love you?
lines.zh: : 她爱你吗？

lines.en: : Who the fuck knows? She loves anyone who will regularly spend time with her. There’s nothing about the way she feels for me that sets me apart from the rest.
lines.zh: : 鬼知道？谁肯经常陪着她，她就爱谁。她对我的那种感觉，跟对别人没有任何区别。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas22
: Is she running around and cheating on you? Because if not, that sounds a lot like your insecurities talking.
lines.zh: : 她有到处乱搞、劈腿骗你吗？如果没有，那听起来完全是你的不安在作祟。

lines.en: : Well...how was it for you? Because Sensei is...well, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那……你那边是什么情况？因为老师他……呃……

lines.en: : Let’s just say it’s hard to really tell where his heart lies sometimes...
lines.zh: : 只能说，有时候真看不出他的心到底在谁身上……

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas23
: Hah...
: I always knew he loved me. But that didn’t mean there were no complications along the way.
lines.zh: : 我一直都知道他爱我。但这不代表一路上就没有波折。

lines.en: : Some people just...have their heartstrings being tugged in different directions.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是……心弦会被不同的方向拉扯。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas24
: And some people are too cowardly to ever really ask why or where.
lines.zh: : 而有些人太懦弱，从来不敢真的去问一句为什么、去了哪里。

lines.en: : Take it from me, you don’t want to be one of those people. If there’s something you’re worried about, ask.
lines.zh: : 听我的，你别当那种人。有担心的事，就开口问。

lines.en: : If you don’t, all of those worries will eat you alive and, before you know it...you’ll be curled up in a ball in your room, wishing for death while writing letters to someone who will probably never see them.
lines.zh: : 不然，那些忧虑会把你一点点啃噬干净，等你回过神来……你就会蜷成一团缩在房间里，一边盼着自己死了算了，一边给一个大概永远看不到的人写信。

lines.en: : It’s...kind of hard imagining you ever being in that position given who you were when I met you.
lines.zh: : 想想我刚认识你时你是什么样，还真……很难想象你会落到那步田地。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas25
: Obviously. I’m a totally flawless and mentally stable superstar now! But I didn’t become that way by ignoring my problems.
lines.zh: : 那是当然。我现在可是完美无缺、心理健康的超级巨星！但我可不是靠逃避问题才变成这样的。

lines.en: : If you’ve got shit you’re worried about or conflict that needs solving, go out there and face it. If you don’t, you’re just going to drag everyone else down alongside you.
lines.zh: : 你有烦心事也好，有待解决的矛盾也好，就出去面对它。不然，你只会把身边所有人一起拖下水。

lines.en: : So, once again, stop being like my scumbag ex and actually start doing shit instead of silently looking down on everyone else and pretending you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 所以，再说一遍：别学我那个混蛋前任，真正去做点什么，别再闷不吭声地俯视所有人、假装自己很幸福。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas26
: I don’t think I’m pretending to be happy. I think it’s more like...I’m waiting for Rin to understand me, and she just...never does. So it makes me doubt myself and I kind of just...go into stasis.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我是在假装幸福。更像是……我在等 Rin 理解我，而她就是……永远都不懂。于是我开始怀疑自己，然后就那么……停摆了。

lines.en: : Do you understand her?
lines.zh: : 你理解她吗？

lines.en: : Not even close.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。

lines.en: : Then what the fuck are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 那你他妈还在这儿耗着干嘛？

lines.en: : Oh God, here it comes. The bus speech.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪，来了来了。那套末班车演讲。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas27
: There will be no “bus speech.” I can’t risk encountering another overly-complex ribbon without someone there to help me get it off.
lines.zh: : 没有什么末班车演讲。我可不敢冒这个险——万一再碰上一根复杂过头的缎带，身边总得有个能帮我解下来的人在。

lines.en: : I just think that standing still is the worst thing you could ever do when it comes to love or like or whatever it is you have with Rin.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，在爱情也好、喜欢也好、随便你跟 Rin 之间那种东西也好，原地不动是最糟的做法。

lines.en: : If you’re happy, stay. If you’re not, leave. But you owe it to that girl to at least be honest about where you two stand so she’s not forced to wait forever just because you’re confused.
lines.zh: : 幸福就留下，不幸福就走人。但你至少欠那女孩一个坦诚——把你们现在到底算什么说清楚，别让她因为你自己都搞不明白，就被迫一直等下去。

lines.en: : That’s shit you should have ironed out before agreeing to be her girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 这种事你该在答应做她女朋友之前就理清楚的。

lines.en: : I just had no idea it was going to be this hard. Keeping your mind on just one person is...it’s tough.
lines.zh: : 我只是没想到会这么难。把心思只放在一个人身上……真的很难。

lines.en: : I know. Especially when that one person doesn’t understand you.
lines.zh: : 我知道。尤其当那个人还不理解你的时候。

lines.en: : But it’s not much different for me since the person I love doesn’t understand me either. The difference is that he and I are actually making progress while you and Rin are moving backwards.
lines.zh: : 但我这边也差不多，因为我爱的人同样不理解我。区别在于，他和我是在往前走，而你跟 Rin 是在往后退。

lines.en: : So...pop quiz time. What am I doing differently?
lines.zh: : 那么……突击提问时间。我哪里做得跟你们不一样？

lines.en: : Making an effort.
lines.zh: : 有在努力。

lines.en: : And you are?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？

lines.en: : Useless and inactive.
lines.zh: : 又废又不动。

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas28
: Take your life into your own hands and pursue a future that will make you happy.
lines.zh: : 把人生攥在自己手里，去追一个能让你幸福的未来。

lines.en: : Every day is another chance to take a stride. To move forward. Even if it’s only a little bit.
lines.zh: : 每一天都是又一次迈步的机会。往前走，哪怕只走一点点。

lines.en: : And from one super talented, super pretty girl to another — you’re never going to be happy if you don’t make a change.
lines.zh: : 然后，从一个超级有才华、超级漂亮的女孩，对另一个女孩说——不做出改变，你永远不会幸福。

lines.en: : Follow my lead...and do what I do. Because I like you, Otoha. And I want you to smile more.
lines.zh: : 跟着我走……照我做的去做。因为我喜欢你，Otoha。我想看你多笑笑。

lines.en: : So...I know I said things wouldn’t end this way, but...
lines.zh: : 所以……我知道我说过不会演变成这样，但是……

lines.en: : Get on the last bus out of here and-
lines.zh: : 搭上从这里开出的末班车，去——

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas29
: Mmf?!
: Chu...
scene nikiotohaxmas30
: Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 哦我的天哪。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas31
: Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 哦我的天哪。

lines.en: : You just kissed me.
lines.zh: : 你刚才亲了我。

lines.en: : Did I?...
: Or did you just...imagine it?...
lines.zh: : 还是说……你只是……自己脑补的？……

lines.en: : Otoha, you are a child.
lines.zh: : Otoha，你还真是个小孩。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas32
: I think I might have...misunderstood where that was going at the end...
lines.zh: : 我想我可能……误会最后那段的走向了……

lines.en: : You think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Okay, you know what? Let’s just forget that ever happened.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这样吧？我们干脆就当什么都没发生过。

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas33
: Otoha, what the fuck?!
lines.zh: : Otoha，你他妈搞什么？！

lines.en: : I’m...I’m sorry, okay?! You just, like...you’re really pretty and...I’ve kinda...you know. And then you grabbed my arm and said to follow your lead and...
lines.zh: : 我……对不起，行了吧？！你就是……你真的好漂亮，然后我也有点……你知道的。后来你抓住我的胳膊，让我跟着你走，然后就……

lines.en: : I thought...you might have been telling me it was okay...
lines.zh: : 我以为……你是在告诉我可以……

lines.en: : To like...take a stride...and stuff...
lines.zh: : 就是……迈出那一步……之类的……

lines.en: : Yeah. Toward your girlfriend. Or literally any other person who is not me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。朝着你女朋友迈。或者随便朝一个不是我的人迈。

lines.en: : But what if it’s...you who makes me-
lines.zh: : 可如果是……你让我——

lines.en: scene nikiotohaxmas34
: Stop. Stop, stop, stop.
lines.zh: : 打住。打住打住打住。

lines.en: : That is not a thing you should tell me. It is not a thing I want to hear. And neither one of us can ever speak of this again. Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 这种事你不该跟我说。我也不想听。而且我们俩谁都不许再提这件事。我的天哪。

lines.en: : Yeah...sorry, I...yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉，我……嗯。

lines.en: : I can’t believe that just happened.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信刚才那一下。

lines.en: : I’m, uhh...
scene nikiotohaxmas35
: You know what? Your tea is probably...cold by now, so...
lines.zh: : 这样吧？你的茶大概……已经凉了，所以……

lines.en: : I’m just gonna...
lines.zh: : 我就先……

lines.en: : Herbal, right?...
lines.zh: : 花草茶，对吧？……

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗯。谢了。

lines.en: : Maybe there’s another Starbucks open at the other end of the venue?...
lines.zh: : 说不定会场另一头还有家星巴克开着？……

lines.en: : There is no fucking way that just happened.
lines.zh: : 刚才那事绝对不可能是真的。

lines.en: scene black
: Niki! You’re on in five! Are you all set?
lines.zh: : Niki！五分钟后你上场！都准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Fuck! Uhh...yeah! Be there in a second!
lines.zh: : 操！呃……好了！马上就到！

lines.zh: 她非常困惑！
